title: Customize themes and layout
description: Choose Cove's colors, surface style, layout, and visual effects.

blocks.text: Open Settings, expand My Settings, and choose Theme. These preferences belong to your account, so changing them does not alter another user's view of the same Cove server.

A palette sets the core background, surface, accent, text, border, and navigation colors. Select a built-in palette for a coordinated result or choose Custom when you want to control the colors yourself.

blocks.alt: Theme settings showing Cove's color palette choices

sections.title: Choose a surface style and page layout

blocks.text: Style changes the treatment of surfaces and controls. Layout changes how navigation and page content are arranged. Additional effect controls appear when the selected style supports them.

blocks.alt: Theme settings showing style, layout, and visual effect controls

blocks.text: Changes apply immediately. Test important list and detail pages before settling on a high-contrast or effect-heavy combination.
